title: Mall world (i think)
content: When I was younger i used to go to “mall world” often when i would dream and it would always be very lucid. Now days it’s a once in a blue moon thing but it’s always recognizable to me. Things i remember distinctly is the main floor feeling almost like an all white airport with no windows. There was a large square seating area in the ground with led music boxes. If you went downstairs it was almost like each door was a portal to a different game but there was one specific tunnel that didn’t take you anywhere and Ive gone there to hide with friends i’ve made in this world a few times. It’s a room filled with stuffed animals so many that it more than just covers all surfaces in the room. Each time i go back the areas more dusty in that room. Does this sound familiar to anyone else? I swear every time i went there it felt almost like a HUB of sorts
